sentences.en: The piano was out of tune; it sounded very bad.
sentences.zh: 钢琴调音不准；听起来很糟糕。

sentences.en: Younger Cubans tend to tune into the American television network.
sentences.zh: 年轻的古巴人倾向于收看美国电视网络。

sentences.en: One of my favorite tunes was playing on the radio.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的歌曲正在广播中播放。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：转动（turn）旋钮调音（tune）
